notes.title: WDC Charity Sale - Save the Whales!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that once again, we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!   

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 30% off Kingdom Rush, Kingdom Rush Origins, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance, Iron Marines, Iron Marines Invasion, and Legends of Kingdom Rush. We will donate 10% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 


[h2]Who is WDC?[/h2]
[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic creatures.

Entanglement in fishing gear, or ‘bycatch’ as it’s known, is the biggest threat whales and dolphins face. Many hundreds of thousands die in nets or get tangled up in fishing gear every year. As air-breathing mammals like us, when they get trapped in a net, panic can take over and they can sustain terrible injuries before either escaping, or suffocating. It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  


[h2]What WDC has been doing so far 
[/h2]Working across the globe to protect whales, dolphins and porpoises from dying in fishing gear: 
[list]
[*] They’re collaborating with creel fishers in Scotland to trial new types of fishing gear to reduce entanglements of humpback and minke whales. 
[*] They’re working with colleagues and partner organisations in the Central Baltic Sea to develop a recovery plan for a critically endangered group of Baltic harbour porpoises. 
[*] On the west coast of the United States, critically endangered North Atlantic right whales are facing extinction. Entanglement is a massive threat to their survival, and WDC have been working with fishers to trial alternative gear types. 
[*] In Hong Kong WDC have been supporting local community efforts and working with fishers to save the remaining 200 Indo-Pacific finless porpoises from extinction due to bycatch.   
[*] These projects are saving lives, and they are powered by inspiring people working together for the ocean. 
[/list]

[h2]How your support will help this year
[/h2]By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue these vital conservation projects across the globe, as well as enable WDC’s team to embark on new efforts to bring further protections for whales and dolphins, like the Sri Lankan gillnet fisheries project: 
[list]
[*]  Sri Lanka is home to many species of whales, dolphins and porpoises as well as a myriad of other sensitive marine species like sea turtles that are vulnerable to entanglement in gillnets – these are nets that hang in the water like a wall. With funding, WDC hopes to collaborate with Sri Lankan artisanal tuna fisheries that use gillnets to trial new gear types and reduce the impact their fishing has on marine life, while still enabling them to earn their living. 
[/list]

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused. 

[b]If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so [url=https://whales.org/ ]here![/url][/b]
Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does [url=https://games.whales.org/ ]here.[/url]
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale [url=https://bit.ly/WODSteamSale25]here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! [/b]
*10% of our net revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).

notes.title: KINGDOM RUSH 5: ALLIANCE, the next chapter in the saga, is on its way!
notes.content:
[b]We have a very big announcement to make!![/b]
[h1]Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance is coming soon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/ba174cace2fdbf6ea8c9888a09f3a1fa1ded2ab6.png[/img]

We’re cooking. And not spaghetti.  
Okay, maybe sometimes it’s spaghetti, but that's beside the point. What we mean is [b]the next Kingdom Rush game is in the works![/b]

Is it a Tower Defense? Absolutely. Is it full of our signature charm, gags and epic action? [i]You betcha![/i]
Have you seen the teaser? Check it out if you haven't already, or watch it again (we won't judge).

[previewyoutube=DhpkLRd8MJs;full][/previewyoutube]

We're still figuring out how to time-travel to the future to get the release date.

notes.title: A frognauts story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/23048d2c4235fa30a56b5ee8f73baab2f3d27edc.png[/img]

The mission started as a normal recon of a new planet. I should have known there was something off about it, but I did not until it was too late. The climate was extremely warm and moist, the terrain was a nightmare to walk in, the soil was sticky and our space boots would get sucked into the muddy surface.

We were trying to find signs of the Vultures on this planet so we walked into the vegetation for hours. Despite feeling observed we could not find any signs of life and our heat sensors did not pick up anything. 

After walking for hours, we decided to set camp on what seemed to be firm terrain. I dozed off until I heard the shouts of my peers. The ground, which until a few hours ago was steady as a rock, had turned into a muddy whirlpool that was engulfing us and our equipment.

The more we moved, the quicker we were pushed to the center of the swirl of death. The urge to move was overpowering, I did not want to die buried under the mud on a lost planet.

As I closed my eyes, getting ready to die, I felt a push from below. When I looked around I found myself surrounded by a bubble. To my astonishment, every single marine was being transported out of the treacherous mud by the same transparent substance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/d64aba1da58bbb4ebcf8146dedb72409879cda5d.gif[/img]

We were transported out of the reach of the deadly soil and carefully deposited on the ground by a frog-like creature holding a huge gun.

The anthropomorphic amphibian adjusted a dial on his suit (we later learned it was a universal translator) and greeted us. He told us they have been monitoring us since the moment we landed on their planet and had decided we were not a threat to them.

We also learned the Crimson Vultures have been attacking their cities, and they were hunting after them. After all they have done for us we offered to join forces to find and eradicate the Vultures as we had extensive knowledge of how they operate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/9c18d421d28cf9046c712ef4a772791baaac9d10.gif[/img]

As we worked together we learned they were a highly technologically advanced race and that they were invisible to our heat radars due to their amphibian nature that provided them with cold blood. We were also fascinated by their unbreakable pact with an amphibian creature race called the Salamandrids, which they use as mounts to swiftly transport themselves.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/059722b0f52bae86118f069a413004cba8e976d6.gif[/img]

A great bond of respect and mutual admiration was forged as we combed the planet, working together to eradicate every single settlement and cell the Vultures had created in the frognauts planet.

By the time the mission was completed and the planet was Vulture-free the Frognauts had decided to join the federation and help us bring aid and peace to other planets of the galaxy, and some of their best agents joined our crew.

notes.title: Ultra joins the fight! The definition of ‘bravery’ is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/1d180d73b376ab8f7b5b742513ae1c52e476ecff.png[/img]

[INCOMING TRANSMISSION - CAP TAGGINS - 52623]

Marine, hope you're coping well with the snowy and hostile conditions at YCYCL III.

It's time for your Squad to push through the Vultures to the rendezvous point. We just deployed the Federation's top elite agent, Ultra, to watch the six of you and ensure the mission succeeds.

She is a true warrior. The very definition of “bravery”. You'll see what I mean.

Take a look at her profile on the data pad, and don't get too distracted by the multitude of awards and decorations. It's the story behind them that makes her truly outstanding. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/5c20f286b13ffb6c46f36c2bf9ccbc42b71d4b53.gif[/img]

See, her platoon was pinned down by the savage Fell. The conditions were so relentless that Federation Headquarters considered the BRAVO TEAM lost. Ultra wouldn't accept that. She powered through, and alone with her fierce willpower, managed to rescue them all.

But it was not without consequences. This heroic action cost her an arm and an eye, later replaced by cybernetic-enhanced prosthetics. 

The platoon vowed to follow her on any mission from then on. She became an inspiration to them. A symbol of loyalty, resilience, and courage. A true leader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/e2b55856187b8456bf87510251b1de52b3322eaa.gif[/img]

And now she's stronger than ever. Her cybernetic armor withstands most damage directed at her, and her shotgun can deal with several enemies at once. Check out her tactical abilities on the data pad. I'm sure you'll find them handy on the field.

[list]
[*] SUPERSHELL: a high-powered, armor-piercing, single target 5 shotshell that pushes enemies away.
[*] BRAVO TEAM: Elite soldiers trained personally by Ultra, ready to be sent to the middle of any conflict. 
[/list]
You're in the best hands, Marine. Meet her at the rendezvous and you're guaranteed to succeed.

Oh! Don't forget to tell her I said hello. 
I'm a huge fan.

Taggins out.

[END OF TRANSMISSION]

notes.title: Meet Halford - The Seasoned Special Ops Veteran
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/3d12b496559cb8401df34fcdf51f541db52a817a.png[/img]

[b][TAGGINS PERSONAL LOG - Wednesday 5.17.23 - Earth Calendar][/b]

Hey Marines, nice to see you ready for battle!

Things on YCYCL III look like they're about to get hot! Those damn Crimson Vultures have really upped their game to raid the Etherium Reserve.

The Federation knows that in maintaining peace among the many worlds of the galaxy, we should not grant any advantage. That's why we're sending you one of the toughest heroes, Halford, to guide you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/05d37c894930c935f16048b279e91f3beaff8f52.gif[/img]

Halford has a wide variety of super high-tech gadgets that help him get out of every mission unscathed without the enemy knowing he was ever there.

His guns can take out groups of weak enemies and his own gun technique to spin all-around shooting all enemies can deal with most threats nearing him.

Carrying a set of two rapid-fire pistols and an array of super high-tech gadgets, Halford is unquestionably a superspy by excellence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/8edb1bfba56c877b4f064e97ed17ac6f0738e0b4.gif[/img]

He manages a special set of skills you'll find pretty handy, like, for example:

GUN JUTSU: In a feat of aim, Halford spins around shooting all enemies within range.
HOLOCLONE : Projects an image of himself so real that it is attacked by enemies.

Find him in the battlefield and brief him quickly to join your mission.
[i]The invasion is coming! Be ready![/i]

notes.title: Learn what led us to this point!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/7ff60d5c8ea2881a6d0e486eb8947d4c81188628.png[/img]

[b][TAGGINS PERSONAL LOG - Wednesday 4.28.23 - Earth Calendar][/b]

Command deck, is this thing on? I can see the light beeping, but… Oh, ok.
Hey Marines, [i]Taggins here![/i]

It’s been five long years since peace among the planets was achieved following our last battle, and much more has been accomplished since.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/c5a010e089c60f53e847339cddb8ce1524223fbd.gif[/img]

The Federation has grown and received many new tactical allies: brave alien clans that you’ll get to know have enlisted to the cause.
Reaching the farthest corners of the galaxy, it has become a beacon of shining light among the alien races. 

Nevertheless, as a retired war veteran, [i]my gut feeling tells me that nothing lasts too long in deep space, and peace among the galaxy is not an exception. [/i]

[b]We’ve just received a distress call coming from the frozen planet YCYCL III! [/b]
A group of criminals known as the Crimson Vultures landed and took control of a village's whole etherium reserve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988932/4987426c974bf00acf378c95cd9751da8f9300ab.gif[/img]

There’s no time to lose - it’s time to call in the Cavalry!
[i]The invasion is coming to us![/i]
